whenToUse: Lists whose goal is to be emptied, such as notifications, inboxes, or to-do lists.
People emptied it by handling items themselves.
You can say when new items will appear.
whenNotToUse: New users' screens with no items from the start (use an empty state).
The last item was just deleted and needs a chance to undo (use an emptied state).
Loading failed and it only looks empty (use an error state).

alternatives.name: Empty State
alternatives.reason: A screen used for the first time.

alternatives.name: Emptied State
alternatives.reason: It's empty because the last item was deleted.

accessibility: Announce that the list is all clear with role="status".
The check mark is decorative, so it's aria-hidden, and the title carries the meaning.
Put the item title in each dismiss button's name ("Dismiss Your order has shipped") to tell the buttons apart.
View past notifications lets people go back to items they handled.
